_note: Hospital facts for PeopleTrack. Copy this file to config/site.json, fill in what you know, and restart the API (or press Apply now under Administration → Settings). Every section is optional: delete a section, or set a value to null, to keep what is in the system. Keys starting with _ are comments. Never put passwords or API keys here: name the environment variable that holds them. Values marked TO CONFIRM are placeholders.

payroll._note: pay_day 0 = the last working day of the month; otherwise the day of the month (moved back to the previous working day if it falls on a weekend or holiday).

bank_file._note: TO CONFIRM: the salary bank's Excel template. Fields available: employee_name, staff_number, national_id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, bank_code, branch_name, branch_code, amount, reference, pay_date, fixed (a constant, with value).
bank_file.name: Bank transfer (Excel)

mpesa._note: TO CONFIRM: method is b2c_portal (Safaricom M-Pesa bulk payment portal), bank_bulk (through the bank's mobile money service) or other. Set the columns to the template that method expects.
mpesa.name: M-Pesa bulk payment (CSV)

chart_of_accounts._note: TO CONFIRM with finance: the general ledger codes for the payroll journal. debit/credit null clears a side; leave a key out to keep it.

medical._note: TO CONFIRM: the scheme's real categories and limits (KES a scheme year). New limits apply from effective_from; earlier claims keep the limits they were made under. job_grade null = everyone not covered by a grade-specific line.

cpd_requirements.description: Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council (published: 50 a calendar year)
Kenya Medical Laboratory Technicians and Technologists Board (published: 50 a calendar year)

performance._note: TO CONFIRM: appraisal ratings are 1 to 5; each band starts at its min. low_rating: completed appraisals below it are flagged to HR.

mandatory_training._note: TO CONFIRM: the hospital's mandatory training list. mandatory_for: all, clinical (licensed or clinical posts) or none. refresh_months null = once.
mandatory_training.title: Basic Life Support (BLS)

sms._note: TO CONFIRM: the Africa's Talking account. The API key stays in the environment variable SMS_API_KEY. Add "sms" to a notification template's channels for it to send texts.

devices._note: TO CONFIRM: one entry per clocking terminal or BioTime server. Types: hikvision_isapi (PeopleTrack pulls), hikvision_push (terminals push), zkteco_biotime (pull from the BioTime server), zkteco_push (devices push via ADMS). Credentials come from the named environment variables. Delete this example entry if you have no devices yet.
devices.name: Main gate terminal
